name: processj-lsp-vscode
description: ProcessJ language support: diagnostics, type checking, formatting, semantic highlighting, run from the editor.

processj.installDir.description: ProcessJ install directory (with bin/ and resources/jars). Empty: use installdir from ~/processjrc or $PROCESSJ_HOME.

processj.checkOnChange.description: Also run the real compiler on every edit (default: only on open and save; the built-in checker runs as you type).

processj.lint.description: Run the built-in type checker and concurrency lints.

processj.serverPath.description: Path to processj-lsp.js. Empty: use the server bundled by the build script.

scripts.install-extension: node scripts/build.js && vsce package --no-dependencies --out processj.vsix && code --install-extension processj.vsix --force
